question: How do I track my order?
answer: Open My Orders in your account and select the order. You will see live tracking, and we also email a tracking link as soon as your order ships.
keywords: track tracking status package parcel shipment whereabouts

question: What is your return policy?
variants: how do I return an item
I want to return my order
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Start a return from My Orders and we will email you a prepaid label.
keywords: return exchange policy send back unused

question: How long does a refund take?
variants: when will I get my refund
answer: Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 business days after we receive your returned item. The money goes back to your original payment method.

question: How long does shipping take?
variants: when will my order be delivered
answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery times are shown at checkout before you pay.
keywords: shipping delivery time days arrive dispatch express standard fast

question: Do you offer free shipping?
answer: Yes. Orders above 999 rupees ship free with standard delivery. Below that amount a flat fee of 49 rupees applies.
keywords: free shipping delivery charge fee cost minimum

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
variants: can I pay with credit card
answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, popular wallets and cash on delivery for orders up to 5000 rupees.
keywords: payment pay card upi netbanking wallet cash cod methods

question: Can I cancel my order?
variants: I want to cancel my order
how do I cancel an order
I changed my mind about my order
answer: You can cancel an order from My Orders until it has been shipped. After shipping, please refuse the delivery or start a return once it arrives.

question: How do I change my delivery address?
variants: send my order to a different address
answer: Go to My Orders and choose Edit Address before the order ships. If it has already shipped, contact support and we will try to redirect the package.
keywords: change edit update address location wrong

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the login page choose Forgot Password, enter your registered email, and follow the reset link we send. The link stays valid for 30 minutes.
keywords: reset forgot password login sign in locked access

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up at the top right, enter your name, email and a password, then verify your email address. You can also sign up with your Google account.
keywords: create register signup account join profile

question: How can I contact customer support?
variants: I want to talk to a human
answer: You can chat with us here, email support@shopease.example, or call 1800-000-000 between 9 AM and 9 PM, Monday to Saturday.
keywords: contact support help phone call email agent customer care

question: Do you ship internationally?
variants: can you deliver to the usa
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days and customs duties are paid by the buyer.
keywords: international abroad overseas worldwide country usa uk america dubai canada global

question: My item arrived damaged. What should I do?
variants: item is missing from my order
answer: We are sorry about that. Report it within 7 days from My Orders with a photo of the item and the packaging, and we will send a replacement or a full refund.
keywords: damaged broken defective faulty wrong missing replacement

question: How do I use a discount code?
variants: where do I enter a coupon
answer: Enter the code in the Promo Code box on the cart page and click Apply. Only one code can be used per order, and some items are excluded.
keywords: discount coupon promo code offer voucher deal sale apply

question: Is my payment information secure?
variants: is it safe to pay on your site
do you store my card details
answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted with SSL and processed by certified payment partners. We never store your full card details.
keywords: secure safe security privacy encryption data trust
